company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security, which goes by CNAS, is a nonprofit founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes its work as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

On artificial intelligence, the site says AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace, a trend it says has fed forecasts about artificial general intelligence. CNAS says it launched the Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, projects it describes as seeking to improve a country's AI self-reliance. Other material on the site discusses a model called Kimi K3 that identified itself as Claude, Anthropic's model, and quotes a comment about a Hugging Face incident followed by the release of a model that is harder to monitor.

The record for CNAS lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile lists it as a nonprofit organization based in Washington, DC, founded in 2007.
